versions.content: Semantics of BlueprintDerivationTime To support blueprints, the tag vh.latestBindingTime may have the value BluePrintDerivation- Time . Such a variation point may only be present in a blueprint and may not be copied to a system configuration. In this case, a variation point cannot have a swSysCond nor postbuildVariant- Condition (as defined by [constr_2558] in [2]) because the information contained in these fields cannot be processed at BluePrintDerivationTime . Similarly, the value an AttributeValueVariationPoint has no meaning in this case. Therefore it shall not be evaluated and the value shall be undefined .
